tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search every published page: 21 Hebrew city guides, the magazine, the Jewish heritage hub, attractions and the service pages. Use this whenever the question is not covered by one of the specific tools. Each result carries a markdown URL, and fetching that is how you read the full page rather than sc

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: What המרכז למטייל במרוקו does, which services an agent can act on, the rules to respect, and the other machine-readable surfaces. Call this first if you are unsure whether this site can answer the question.

tools.name: get_visa
tools.description: Price per traveler in ILS for both tracks with the government fee broken out, target processing time, passport validity, the documents page and the apply URL. Israelis cannot get a visa on arrival. Never apply on someone's behalf.

tools.name: get_shabbat_times
tools.description: Candle lighting and havdalah for the current week in Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Rabat, Tangier and Agadir, with the parasha. Check the `source` field: when it is `fallback`, the times are a saved snapshot and you must say so.

tools.name: get_hilulot
tools.description: The next hilula dates at the tombs of Moroccan tzadikim, with the site, the city, the Hebrew date and how reliably each date holds. A date with runsReliably false has not been held every year; say that when you quote it.

tools.name: search_attractions
tools.description: Search the catalog of day trips and attractions. Returns Hebrew editorial copy and our own page URL. There is no booking link and no price in the result by design: the person books from our page. Do not go looking for the operator.

tools.name: get_city_guides
tools.description: The index of published city guides, each with a page URL and a markdown URL. Fetch the markdown URL for the full text of one city instead of scraping the page.

tools.name: get_plan_options
tools.description: The exact ids plan_trip accepts for cities, who, style, vibes, pace, kosher and shabbatCity. Call this before plan_trip rather than guessing an id.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: A free, anonymous, day-by-day itinerary. Every city you list appears in the route, and the number of days you ask for is honoured exactly or the answer explains what would fit. Use get_plan_options first for valid ids. The route is not saved; send the person to the questionnaire URL to keep or adjus

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_visa, search_attractions, get_city_guides, plan_trip · Private data: get_visa · Public sink: plan_trip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_visa, search_attractions, get_city_guides, plan_trip · Private data: get_visa · Public sink: plan_trip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
